note: User requested to pause the currencyservice for 30 seconds.

plan.hypothesis: An unresponsive currencyservice does not tie up its callers: they time out rather than hang until the request budget is exhausted.
plan.expected_observations: Latency on dependent paths rises to a bounded deadline, not to the probe timeout; callers without a deadline will hang (a finding).
plan.recovery_criteria: currencyservice is unpaused and latency returns to baseline.
